ublock.popup.blocked.message: {count, plural, one {# request blocked} other {# requests blocked}}
ublock.popup.blocked.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): large count of requests blocked on the current page.

ublock.popup.share.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): line under the blocked count; {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100.

ublock.popup.domains.message: {count, plural, one {{connected} of # domain connected} other {{connected} of # domains connected}}
ublock.popup.domains.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): how many of the page’s domains were allowed to connect; {connected} is that number, the count is all domains the page contacted.

ublock.popup.pick.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): tool that starts uBlock Origin’s element picker.

ublock.popup.pickDetail.message: Create a filter that hides it
ublock.popup.pickDetail.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): line under “Pick an element”.

ublock.popup.zap.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): tool that starts uBlock Origin’s element zapper, which removes an element until reload.

ublock.popup.zapDetail.message: Remove it until the page reloads
ublock.popup.zapDetail.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): line under “Zap an element”.

ublock.popup.logger.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): link that opens uBlock Origin’s request logger (same tool as Settings → “Logger”).

ublock.popup.dashboard.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): link that opens uBlock Origin’s settings dashboard.

ublock.popup.more.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): button that expands the popup with site controls and the request table.

ublock.popup.fewer.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): the same button while expanded; collapses it again.

ublock.popup.overflow.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): accessible name of the “…” menu button.

ublock.popup.report.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): item in the “…” menu that opens uBlock Origin’s issue reporter.

ublock.popup.since.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): label in the “…” menu beside the number of requests blocked since uBlock Origin was installed.

ublock.popup.siteControls.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): heading of the expanded section with per-site switches.

ublock.popup.saveRules.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): button that makes this session’s rule changes permanent.

ublock.popup.revert.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): button that discards this session’s rule changes.

ublock.popup.reload.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): button that reloads the page so rule changes apply.

ublock.popup.requestsAndDomains.note: uBlock Origin popup (opened from the shield popover): heading of the table of requests by domain.

ublock.dashboard.frame.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard: accessible title of the frame that shows the selected settings pane.

ublock.dashboard.panels.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard: accessible name of the row of pane tabs.

ublock.dashboard.lists.message: Choose which lists uBlock Origin uses.
ublock.dashboard.lists.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.settings.message: Customize filtering, appearance, and your uBlock Origin preferences.
ublock.dashboard.settings.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Settings: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.myFilters.message: Add your own network and cosmetic filters.
ublock.dashboard.myFilters.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → My filters: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.rules.message: Review permanent rules and changes for this session.
ublock.dashboard.rules.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → My rules: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.trusted.message: Choose where uBlock Origin filtering is turned off.
ublock.dashboard.trusted.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Trusted sites: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.support.message: Find help and troubleshoot uBlock Origin.
ublock.dashboard.support.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Support: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.about.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → About: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.advanced.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Advanced settings: description under the pane title.

ublock.dashboard.advancedTitle.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Advanced settings: pane title (the other panes use uBlock Origin’s own titles).

ublock.dashboard.listOptions.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: heading of the options column.

ublock.dashboard.autoUpdate.message: Periodically check and update filter lists in the background.
ublock.dashboard.autoUpdate.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: description under uBlock Origin’s auto-update option.

ublock.dashboard.suspend.message: Prevent network requests until filtering rules are ready.
ublock.dashboard.suspend.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: description under the option that holds requests while lists load.

ublock.dashboard.cosmetic.message: Enable cosmetic filters to hide page elements.
ublock.dashboard.cosmetic.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: description under the cosmetic filtering option.

ublock.dashboard.genericCosmetic.message: Skip generic cosmetic filters (e.g. those not specific to a site).
ublock.dashboard.genericCosmetic.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: description under the option that ignores generic cosmetic filters.

ublock.dashboard.subscriptions.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: heading of the list of filter lists.

ublock.dashboard.importList.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: row that expands to import a list by URL.

ublock.dashboard.search.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: placeholder of the list search field.

ublock.dashboard.searchLabel.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: accessible name of the list search field.

ublock.dashboard.allLists.note: uBlock Origin Dashboard → Filter lists: accessible name of a group expander that has no name of its own.

ws.new.note: Spaces menu: the command that opens the editor for a new space.

ws.list.emptyHint.message: Save a set of tabs and switch back to it any time.
ws.list.emptyHint.note: Spaces menu, shown when there are no spaces yet.

ws.row.edit.note: Accessible name of the ••• button on a space row; {name} is the space's own name.

ws.undo.deleted.note: Spaces menu row after a space is deleted; {name} is the space's own name. An Undo button follows.

ws.undo.button.note: Button that brings back the space just deleted.

ws.editor.newTitle.note: Spaces menu: heading of the editor for a new space.

ws.editor.editTitle.note: Spaces menu: heading of the editor for an existing space.

ws.editor.name.note: Space editor: accessible name and placeholder of the space name field.

ws.editor.color.note: Space editor: label above the color swatches.

ws.editor.symbol.note: Space editor: label above the grid of symbols.

ws.editor.startWith.note: New space editor: label of the choice between this window's tabs and an empty space.

ws.editor.thisWindow.message: {count, plural, one {This window · # tab} other {This window · # tabs}}
ws.editor.thisWindow.note: New space editor: segment that saves this window's ordinary tabs into the new space.

ws.editor.empty.note: New space editor: segment that starts the new space with no tabs.

ws.editor.done.note: Space editor: primary button; changes are already saved.

ws.error.invalidColor.message: That isn’t a color Blanc can use. Pick a swatch, or enter a hex color like #426C4C.
ws.error.invalidColor.note: Space editor error for an unusable color value.

ws.error.invalidSymbol.message: That symbol isn’t available. Pick one from the list.
ws.error.invalidSymbol.note: Space editor error for an unknown symbol.

ws.decision.title.note: Heading of the prompt shown before switching would close tabs; {name} is the space's own name.

ws.decision.saveThenSwitch.message: Save them as a space, then switch
ws.decision.saveThenSwitch.note: Switch prompt: primary button that saves this window's tabs as a new space before switching.
